description: This PHP source file manages the saving and validation of mail scanner configuration in the vtiger CRM system. It handles user input, validates parameters, creates or updates mail scanner information objects, and manages the connection to the mail server, including error handling and UI setup.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerInfo
classes.description: Class representing mail scanner configuration and status information within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares current scanner info with another for changes.

methods.name: getAsMap
methods.description: Returns the scanner info as an associative array.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates scanner info with new data.

methods.name: updateAllFolderRescan
methods.description: Sets the rescan flag for all folders.

methods.name: updateLastscan
methods.description: Updates the last scanned timestamp for a folder.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailBox
classes.description: Represents a mailbox connection, supporting connection establishment and folder management.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security issues.

methods.name: validateAlphanumericInput
methods.description: Validates that input string contains only alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Returns language strings for a module.
